nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used in ownership guards, allowance spender checks and minting
owner: privileged address set in constructor; guards init, batchSend, setTradeAddress and delegate
balanceOf: public mapping holding token balances
allowance: public nested mapping of approvals
_onSaleNum: per-address sell counter incremented on every transfer
canSale: whitelist mapping that bypasses the condition() sell checks
_saleNum: maximum number of sells per address configured by init
_minSale: minimum transfer value configured by init
_maxSale: maximum transfer value configured by init
tradeAddress: extra whitelisted address set by the owner through setTradeAddress
totalSupply: entire token supply minted to the deployer
UNI: constant Uniswap router address whitelisted inside ensure
transfer(address,uint): payable public entry that forwards to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender
transferFrom(address,uint): payable public transfer path with unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic and whitelist enforcement
approve(address,uint): payable public approval setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender]
ensure(address,address,uint): internal whitelist gate returning true for privileged or whitelisted senders
condition(address,uint): internal sell-limit checker over _saleNum/_minSale/_maxSale/_onSaleNum
delegate(address,bytes): owner-only arbitrary delegatecall entry point
init(uint,uint,uint): owner-only configuration of the sale limits
batchSend(address[],uint): owner-only batch distribution of value to many recipients
setTradeAddress(address): owner-only whitelist setter
pairFor(address,address,address): internal pure Uniswap pair address computation
constructor(string,string,uint): mints the supply to the deployer and pre-approves the Uniswap router
a.delegatecall(b): arbitrary delegatecall executed in this contract's storage context
balanceOf[_from] -= _value: unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
balanceOf[_to] += _value: unchecked addition without SafeMath
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value: unchecked subtraction without SafeMath
total = _value * _tos.length: unchecked multiplication without SafeMath
_from parameter of transferFrom and ensure
_to parameter of transferFrom
_value parameter of transfer, transferFrom and condition
_tos recipient array parameter of batchSend
addr parameter of setTradeAddress
a target address parameter of delegate
b calldata parameter of delegate
saleNum parameter of init
token minimum-sale parameter of init
maxToken parameter of init
total: local variable in batchSend holding _value * _tos.length
i: loop index in batchSend
_UNI: locally computed Uniswap pair address inside ensure

edges.reason: delegate is gated by require(msg.sender == owner), so the caller controls whether the delegatecall executes
batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
init is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
msg.sender is used as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented in transferFrom
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] using the caller address
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the whole supply in the constructor
transfer passes msg.sender as the _from argument to transferFrom
the owner state variable is the privileged identity compared in delegate's guard
ensure treats _from == owner or _to == owner as a whitelisted transfer that bypasses condition()
delegate performs the arbitrary delegatecall on the owner-supplied target
transferFrom decrements balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath, allowing underflow
transferFrom increments balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication
transfer forwards execution to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value)
transferFrom requires ensure(_from, _to, _value) to pass before moving balances
ensure falls back to condition() for callers that are not whitelisted or privileged
canSale[_from] is read as a whitelist bypass inside ensure
tradeAddress is read as a whitelist bypass inside ensure
the constant UNI router address is whitelisted inside ensure
ensure computes the expected Uniswap pair address using pairFor
condition reads _saleNum to bound the number of sells
condition reads _minSale to bound the minimum value
condition reads _maxSale to bound the maximum value
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] to compare against _saleNum
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for sender and recipient
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender]
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after a successful transfer
approve stores the new value into the allowance mapping
init writes _minSale from the token parameter
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress whitelist state variable
the constructor assigns owner = msg.sender
the constructor sets totalSupply from _supply
the constructor credits the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender]
the constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router

normalization_plan.reason: _from is the sender argument consumed directly by the transferFrom balance and whitelist logic
_to is the recipient argument consumed directly by transferFrom
_value is the amount argument consumed by transferFrom arithmetic and the allowance check
_tos is the recipient array iterated over by the owner-only batchSend loop
addr is the value stored into tradeAddress by setTradeAddress
a is the target of the delegatecall performed inside delegate
b is the calldata forwarded to the delegatecall inside delegate
saleNum is assigned to _saleNum by the owner-only init function
token is scaled and assigned to _minSale by init
maxToken is scaled and assigned to _maxSale by init
total is the result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication in batchSend
i is only the loop index of the batchSend iteration
_UNI is a purely local pair address computed inside ensure and used only for the whitelist comparison
